subject: Service remediation and concession request — SentriHealth latency incidents
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@sentrihealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, support@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@sentrihealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Repeated latency spikes during integration window — request for remediation and credit

Hi Stephanie,

We've been running a large-scale integration test against your hosted inference endpoint (model: rwd-medium-v2) and observed three separate latency spikes on 2027-05-23 between 10:04–10:22 PDT and again on 2027-05-24 14:30–14:55 PDT that pushed median tail latencies to over 1.6s (normally ~220ms). These blips caused our UI to time out on several demo flows and blocked our QA sign-off for next-week production roll-out.

We logged incident IDs SH-7221 and SH-7234 with your status page but need a formal remediation plan and a proposal for a service offset. Per our contract (SLA section), uptime and P95 latency targets are material to our business case, and the impact this week reached the threshold for an SLA concession.

Actions requested:
- A postmortem with root cause and mitigation steps
- Proposed concession: either pro-rated credit for May usage or a one-month complimentary premium support window (our preference is a billing credit)
- Target timeline: proposed remedy and concession terms by EOD Monday (2027-05-31) so we can finalize our renewal conversation.

I've attached screenshots and a short timeline. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Park
VP Product, SentriHealth
[attachment: incident_screenshots.zip (archive)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@sentrihealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, support@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes during integration window — request for remediation and credit

Hi Elena — thank you for flagging this and for the detail. I'm sorry SentriHealth ran into those latency disruptions during a critical integration run. We take SLA impacts seriously.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I've escalated to our infrastructure and serving-runtime teams and asked for a prioritized postmortem. Expect the preliminary notes within 48 hours.
- I'm pulling historic telemetry and will scope the approx. impacted tokens and sessions so we can calculate a fair concession.
- Can you confirm whether the affected requests were routed through our us-west-2 hosted pool or the dedicated tenant? That will help speed calculations.

For transparency, possible concession structures we're considering:
1) Straight pro-rated credit for impacted billing period (May 2027) tied to measured request volume.
2) Fixed account credit (one-time dollar amount) + two months of elevated support (SLA bumped to 99.99% SLO phone on-call).
3) A free month of premium tier (waive next month's subscription invoice) while we add a kinetic cache layer to their deployment.

I'll coordinate an internal recommendation and route to Exec signoff by Friday.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success — North America
Redwood Inference
[attachment: received_elena_screens.zip (archive)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Recommendation for SentriHealth concession — cost & impact analysis

Team,

I dug into the telemetry and billing for SH-7221/SH-7234. Quick summary:
- Impact window: two main spikes (2027-05-23 10:04–10:22 PDT, 2027-05-24 14:30–14:55 PDT).
- Estimated affected tokens: ~1.1M tokens (aggregate across test runs).
- Estimated incremental cost to Redwood (GPU cycles, priority scheduling) ≈ $3,600.
- Business risk: SentriHealth is at renewal stage (Q3 upsell conversation, ARR ~ $540k). Loss of confidence here likely increases churn risk.

Recommendation (preferred):
- Offer a blended concession: immediate $6,000 account credit (covers incremental cost + goodwill) + waive next month's premium subscription (equivalent value ~$8,400) if SentriHealth signs a 12-month renewal by July 15. Total short-term revenue impact ≈ $14,400 but preserves renewal upside.

Rationale: a straight token-pro-rated credit is harder to reconcile operationally and doesn't give a renewal incentive. The blended package is simpler for finance/legal to approve and aligns with our commercial goals.

Attachments: SLO_breakdown_May2027.xlsx (breakdown by endpoint) and draft_concession_letter.docx (template). Please advise if we should increase the credit or go with a simpler $10k one-time credit.

-Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: slo_breakdown_may2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@sentrihealth.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.com, deals@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: SentriHealth remediation package and exec sign-off

Hi all — after reviewing the telemetry and the renewal context, I approve the blended concession. Final terms authorized: 

- One-time account credit of $6,000 to be applied to SentriHealth's June invoice.
- Waive the premium-tier fee for one month (July 2027).
- Condition: SentriHealth provides written acceptance of these terms and signals intent to complete a 12-month renewal by July 15; otherwise, the waiver converts to a $3,000 account credit.

Please:
1) Stephanie — send Elena a short concession letter confirming the above and attach the postmortem once complete.
2) Deals/Legal — prepare a simple amendment and DocuSign packet for the renewal incentive and the conditional clause.
3) Support/Infra — schedule a technical working session with SentriHealth's engineering leads this week to implement mitigation and add caching rules.

Thanks for moving this quickly. Stephanie, loop me in on the sent notice.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[attachment: draft_concession_letter.docx (draft)]
